is_anopheles.evidence: Anopheles gambiae s.l. larvae were collected in six study sites in Cote d'Ivoire (Page 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: We determined the frequency of target-site mutations, including Vgsc-L995F/S and Vgsc-N1570Y, and Ace1-G280S (Page 3, Page 10, Figure 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts and allele frequencies for Vgsc-L995F, Vgsc-N1570Y, and Ace1-G280S across six field sites (N=50 per site) are presented in Figure 4 and main text (Page 10, Page 22).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from field sites in Agboville, Tiassale, Azaguie, Dabou, Issia, and Soubre in Cote d'Ivoire in 2018 and 2019 and reared to adult (Page 5-6).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper presents primary empirical field sampling, WHO susceptibility bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Exact coordinates and town names provided: Agboville, Tiassale, Azaguie, Dabou, Issia, and Soubre (Page 5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larvae were collected in June-July 2018 in Agboville, Azaguie, Dabou, and Tiassale, and in June 2019 in Issia and Soubre (Page 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary field collections conducted specifically for this study in 2018 and 2019 across six agricultural sites.

supplement.evidence: All primary genotype frequencies and sample counts are fully presented in Figure 4 and the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site resistance marker frequencies (Vgsc-L995F, Vgsc-L995S, Vgsc-N1570Y, Ace1-G280S) along with gene expression in field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. across six agricultural sites in Cote d'Ivoire in 2018 and 2019.
